volseq_pathline_orbit — LIVE4D flow op

• Datenarten: volseq → rgbvideo

• Aufruf: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.volseq_pathline_orbit(volseq, n_frames: 'int' = 36, n_seeds: 'int' = 200, pitch: 'float' = 25.0, size: 'int' = 256, yaw_start: 'float' = 0.0, yaw_span: 'float' = 360.0, static_alpha: 'float' = 0.03, win: 'int' = 3, pyr_levels: 'int' = 3, iters: 'int' = 5, reg: 'float' = 0.001, seed: 'int' = 0, trail_sigma: 'float' = 0.7, min_speed: 'float' = 0.1, min_intensity: 'float' = 0.3) -> 'np.ndarray' (die Implementierung direkt: import live4d; live4d.volseq_pathline_orbit(volseq, n_frames: 'int' = 36, n_seeds: 'int' = 200, pitch: 'float' = 25.0, size: 'int' = 256, yaw_start: 'float' = 0.0, yaw_span: 'float' = 360.0, static_alpha: 'float' = 0.03, win: 'int' = 3, pyr_levels: 'int' = 3, iters: 'int' = 5, reg: 'float' = 0.001, seed: 'int' = 0, trail_sigma: 'float' = 0.7, min_speed: 'float' = 0.1, min_intensity: 'float' = 0.3) -> 'np.ndarray'; aus dem Register: opslive4d.get("volseq_pathline_orbit"))

Verwendung

> Für diesen Operator gibt es noch keine Übersetzung. Es folgt der Originaltext unverändert.

`volseq_pathline_render の軌跡の立体を回して見る (n_frames, size, size, 3)(rgbvideo`)。

流れと軌跡は 1 回だけ計算し、視点だけを `yaw_start から yaw_span 度ぶん回す。video_write_gif` で

そのまま GIF に書ける。
